# Every production method each razed building can run, outside its ownership groups. MODE:
# record / restore around the rebuild (nd_raze_pm_record, nd_raze_pm_restore), and sc_arm /
# sc_read for the once-a-game self-check (nuclear_raze_rebuild).
nd_raze_pms_building_advanced_material_fabricator = {
	nd_raze_pm_$MODE$ = { BUILDING = building_advanced_material_fabricator PM = pm_basic_am_fabrication }
	nd_raze_pm_$MODE$ = { BUILDING = building_advanced_material_fabricator PM = pm_advanced_am_fabrication }
	nd_raze_pm_$MODE$ = { BUILDING = building_advanced_material_fabricator PM = pm_self_replicating_assemblers }
	nd_raze_pm_$MODE$ = { BUILDING = building_advanced_material_fabricator PM = pm_advanced_self_replicating_assemblers }
	nd_raze_pm_$MODE$ = { BUILDING = building_advanced_material_fabricator PM = pm_lab_am_fabrication }
	nd_raze_pm_$MODE$ = { BUILDING = building_advanced_material_fabricator PM = pm_synthetic_bacteria_am_fabrication }
	nd_raze_pm_$MODE$ = { BUILDING = building_advanced_material_fabricator PM = pm_automated_am_fabrication }
	nd_raze_pm_$MODE$ = { BUILDING = building_advanced_material_fabricator PM = pm_basic_production }
	nd_raze_pm_$MODE$ = { BUILDING = building_advanced_material_fabricator PM = pm_orbital_fabrication }
	nd_raze_pm_$MODE$ = { BUILDING = building_advanced_material_fabricator PM = pm_maintenance }
	nd_raze_pm_$MODE$ = { BUILDING = building_advanced_material_fabricator PM = pm_no_maintenance }
}

# State scope: rebuild $BUILDING$ at the rung at or below var:nd_raze_left (at least 1),
# every level owned by the state's owner, and record the levels built in var:nd_raze_built
# and in the state's levels still standing, var:nd_raze_nat. create_building's levels
# are literals (scripting_best_practices.md § "`create_building` Does NOT Accept
# Variables for `level`").
nd_raze_build_owned = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:nd_raze_left < 2 }
		create_building = { building = $BUILDING$ add_ownership = { country = { country = owner levels = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { name = nd_raze_built value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:nd_raze_left < 3 }
		create_building = { building = $BUILDING$ add_ownership = { country = { country = owner levels = 2 } } }
		set_variable = { name = nd_raze_built value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:nd_raze_left < 4 }
		create_building = { building = $BUILDING$ add_ownership = { country = { country = owner levels = 3 } } }
		set_variable = { name = nd_raze_built value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:nd_raze_left < 5 }

	change_variable = { name = nd_raze_nat add = var:nd_raze_built }
}

# State scope: rebuild $BUILDING$, a government building, at the rung at or below
# var:nd_raze_left (at least 1), and record the levels built in var:nd_raze_built and in
# var:nd_raze_nat (a government building's levels are the state's already).
nd_raze_build_plain = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:nd_raze_left < 2 }
		create_building = { building = $BUILDING$ level = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = nd_raze_built value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:nd_raze_left < 3 }

# State scope (saved as scope:nd_raze_sc_site), from nuclear_weapon_events.34 a few days
# after the self-check armed (nd_raze_selfcheck_arm): read the rebuilt building's level and
# government share (the fraction read from building scope, as te_demog_um_effects.txt does) and
# check each production method recorded at the rebuild is active, then give the verdict
# (nd_raze_selfcheck_verdict). var:nd_raze_sc_type is the building's branch number in
# nd_raze_all_buildings.
nd_raze_selfcheck_read = {
	set_variable = { name = nd_raze_sc_level value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = nd_raze_sc_gov value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = nd_raze_sc_pm_miss value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = nd_raze_sc_pm_seen value = 0 }
	switch = {
		trigger = var:nd_raze_sc_type
		1 = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_advanced_material_fabricator }
				set_variable = { name = nd_raze_sc_level value = b:building_advanced_material_fabricator.level }
				b:building_advanced_material_fabricator = {
					scope:nd_raze_sc_site = { set_variable = { name = nd_raze_sc_gov value = prev.country_ownership_fraction } }
				}
			}
			nd_raze_pms_building_advanced_material_fabricator = { MODE = sc_read }
		}
		2 = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_aerospace_industry }
				set_variable = { name = nd_raze_sc_level value = b:building_aerospace_industry.level }
				b:building_aerospace_industry = {
					scope:nd_raze_sc_site = { set_variable = { name = nd_raze_sc_gov value = prev.country_ownership_fraction } }
				}
			}
			nd_raze_pms_building_aerospace_industry = { MODE = sc_read }
		}
		3 = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_airport }
				set_variable = { name = nd_raze_sc_level value = b:building_airport.level }
				b:building_airport = {
					scope:nd_raze_sc_site = { set_variable = { name = nd_raze_sc_gov value = prev.country_ownership_fraction } }
				}
			}

		}
		4 = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_arms_industry }

		5 = {

		6 = {
			if = {
